name: Beginner Training Ground
lore: A tranquil courtyard designed for novice adventurers to master swordplay and spellcasting basics.

name: Whispering Forest
lore: Ancient dense woodland where bioluminescent flora guide wanderers past mischievous spirit traps.

name: Sunken Catacombs
lore: Flooded subterranean tomb echoing with whispers of forgotten monarchs and water demons.

name: Desert Labyrinth
lore: Shifting sand dunes sheltering clockwork monoliths and ancient mirage puzzles.

name: Obsidian Sanctuary
lore: Sacred volcanic altar carved from glass-hard black volcanic rock radiating latent magma energy.

name: Crystal Mine Depths
lore: Deep cavern veins packed with humming resonant crystals that refract unstable arcane light.

name: Windspire Peak
lore: High altitude watchtower where ferocious gale currents test the agility of aerial gliders.

name: Frozen Abyss
lore: A permafrost glacial canyon concealing frost wyrm relics encased in unbreakable blue ice.

name: Thunder Bastion
lore: Electrified fortress pinnacle constantly attracting storm lightning into ancient battery cells.

name: Astral Void Chamber
lore: Weightless pocket dimension floating between cosmic rifts, accessible only to master dimensionalists.
